What the scope can include

A condition survey decides what should be retained, repaired or replaced.

Care continues during the workHygiene-first materials and carefully released zones support a safer phased renovation.
01Clinic refurbishmentUpdate reception, waiting, consultation and treatment spaces.
02Pharmacy renovationImprove dispensing, counters, storage, customer flow and display.
03Laboratory upgradesCoordinate worktops, services, equipment positions and easy-clean surfaces.
04Diagnostic centre worksReplan patient movement, procedure rooms and support areas.
05Hygiene-focused finishesSpecify durable, cleanable and low-maintenance materials by zone.
06Building services coordinationPlan lighting, power, plumbing, ventilation and specialist equipment interfaces.

A process shaped for healthcare renovation

Survey, scope, BOQ and phasing are agreed before disruptive work starts.

01

Clinical audit

Map patient flow, active rooms, equipment and hygiene controls.

02

Service continuity plan

Agree isolation, temporary routes and rooms that must remain active.

03

Design and approvals input

Coordinate the renovation package; the client retains responsibility for formal regulatory approvals.

04

BOQ and protected execution

Price each zone, isolate work areas and control dust and access.

05

Testing and handover

Clean, inspect and return each completed area to service.

items.q: Can a clinic remain operational during renovation?
items.a: Often, yes. We phase rooms, protect routes and agree infection-control measures with the client before work starts.
We prioritise durable, easy-clean finishes appropriate to each room, with slip resistance and maintenance considered early.

items.q: Do you handle formal healthcare approvals?
items.a: Woodex coordinates the design and renovation information, but the client remains responsible for formal regulatory and clinical approvals.

items.q: Can you renovate pharmacies and laboratories?
items.a: Yes. We coordinate counters, storage, equipment positions, services and circulation for these spaces.

items.q: How long does healthcare renovation take?
items.a: Timing depends on the number of active rooms, service shutdowns and hygiene controls. The phased programme is agreed before execution.

items.q: Is the BOQ itemized by room?
items.a: Yes. Rooms, finishes, services and specialist coordination can be separated clearly in the BOQ.
